_comment: Footstep SFX (see include/Footsteps.h). A speed-scaled timer plays a random variation from the pool for the SURFACE under the pilgrim (the LDtk surface tag that also drives terrain collision -- see config/surfaces.json). walk_cadence/run_cadence are the seconds between steps at each pace. Pool keys MUST match the surface names exactly (LDtk capitalizes them). A surface with no pool is silent -- Water has none until a swim/wade sound exists. default_surface is used for untagged tiles (bare ground). Audio chopped from field recordings via scripts/chop_footsteps.py, peak-normalized to -1 dBFS.
